Shadow

You learn the unguarded routes through a world that rarely looks in the right direction.

Rules

Agreed: minimum 0 in Agility, Guile; HP contribution +3. No multiclassing.

Starting disciplines: choose two distinct rank-1 disciplines from Subterfuge, Marksmanship, Mind, Athletics.

Discipline pricing: Home: Subterfuge, Marksmanship. Adjacent: Mind, Athletics. All others Foreign; no Opposed disciplines.

Choose one class-exclusive signature at levels 1, 3 and 7. Extra signatures cost 2/4/8 DP. No discipline requirements.

Level 1 choices

- @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.7ffedf579af69498.JournalEntryPage.bf2ae4b6f74e0a1c]{Fade Behind} - @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.1188da9545fdfba9.JournalEntryPage.c711f918d88000cb]{Soft Landing} - @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.b6a487204bdb701c.JournalEntryPage.a4dc06102ca5b69d]{Turn Their Eye}

Level 3 choices

- @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.a1cc81888bfbb3ec.JournalEntryPage.84b5cf5b903acb15]{Pass the Guard} - @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.4b78d7732bfcb61b.JournalEntryPage.d9a8142fc8daa3a3]{Strike and Vanish} - @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.119922db1126bf66.JournalEntryPage.2061892935493c33]{Open the Way}

Level 7 choices

- @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.5f29c71b457857c0.JournalEntryPage.3da54551af2ff0dc]{Unseen Passage} - @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.74b07d8959f90fc6.JournalEntryPage.3c2a135b5c4dc418]{Exploit Confusion} - @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.f5bd34b7bbc7716c.JournalEntryPage.aa6c4ae80c590621]{Leave No Pursuit}

Signature identity in play

The revised options aim for these moments, with a deliberate advantage over shared cards of their tier. Each is an independent choice, not a progression chain.

- Level 1: Slip away, land quietly, or cover an ally's passage. - Level 3: Cross difficult ground, strike and leave, or open a lock quickly. - Level 7: Shroud an escape, exploit a companion's disabling effect, or hide a party's trail.

Starting coin contribution: +3 coins. See @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.0558be1f6014ee71.JournalEntryPage.880380bcd80cfec6]{starting coins}.
